date_display_zh: 2026 年 4 月 22 日·星期三
tagline_zh: 由 AI 為你策展，專屬早晨讀物

articles.title_zh: SpaceX 以 600 億美元收購 AI 程式開發平台 Cursor
articles.title_en: SpaceX strikes $60 billion deal to acquire AI coding platform Cursor
articles.lede_zh: SpaceX 宣布以 600 億美元收購 AI 程式碼編輯器 Cursor，若交易失敗將支付 100 億美元費用。此舉旨在強化旗下 xAI 在 AI 輔助開發領域的競爭力，追趕 OpenAI 與 Anthropic。
articles.lede_en: SpaceX announced a $60 billion agreement to acquire Cursor, the AI-assisted coding platform. If the deal falls through, SpaceX will pay a $10 billion fee. The move aims to boost xAI's competitiveness against OpenAI and Anthropic ahead of a planned IPO.
bullets_zh: 收購總價 600 億美元，失敗需付 100 億
SpaceX/xAI/X 三家公司籌備合併上市
xAI 加速追趕 OpenAI 與 Anthropic
bullets_en: Deal valued at $60B with $10B breakup fee
SpaceX/xAI/X combo preparing joint IPO filing
xAI races to catch OpenAI and Anthropic rivals

articles.title_zh: Anthropic 調查旗艦模型 Mythos 遭未授權存取
articles.title_en: Anthropic probes unauthorized access to powerful Mythos AI model
articles.lede_zh: Anthropic 正在調查其最新 AI 模型 Mythos 遭遇未授權存取事件。由於擔憂該模型具備駭客攻擊能力，公司已限制模型發布範圍。
articles.lede_en: Anthropic is investigating unauthorized access to its cutting-edge Mythos model. The company has restricted the tool's release due to concerns about its potential hacking capabilities.
bullets_zh: Mythos 模型遭未知管道未授權存取
擔憂模型能力遭用於駭客攻擊
AI 安全治理成產業關鍵議題
bullets_en: Mythos model compromised through unknown channels
Fears tool capabilities could enable hacking attacks
AI safety governance becomes critical industry issue

articles.title_zh: 中國 AI 全球擴張遭遇阻力，巴西數據中心引發環境爭議
articles.title_en: China's global AI push meets resistance as Brazil data center faces environmental concerns
articles.lede_zh: TikTok 計畫在巴西海岸投資 95 億美元興建數據中心，反映中國國家級 AI 基礎設施拓展野心，卻引發當地環保疑慮。
articles.lede_en: TikTok plans to build a $9.5 billion data center on Brazil's coast, reflecting China's national AI infrastructure ambitions. However, the project faces opposition over environmental concerns.
bullets_zh: TikTok 巴西建廠投資達 95 億美元
反映中國國家級 AI 擴張戰略
當地環保團體質疑能源使用效益
bullets_en: TikTok invests $9.5B in Brazilian coastal facility
Project reflects China's national AI expansion strategy
Local groups question the project energy allocation

articles.title_zh: Google 提出 ReasoningBank 框架，讓 AI 從經驗中學習推理
articles.title_en: Google Research introduces ReasoningBank to help agents learn from experience
articles.lede_zh: Google Research 發表 ReasoningBank，一項讓 AI 代理從過往推理經驗中學習的框架，有助於提升代理重複任務的推理品質。
articles.lede_en: Google Research unveiled ReasoningBank, a framework enabling AI agents to learn reasoning patterns from past experiences. The approach promises to improve agent performance on recurring tasks.
bullets_zh: 建立可重複使用的推理模式資料庫
AI 不再每次從頭推理相同問題
代理系統學習能力邁向新階段
bullets_en: Creates a reusable library of reasoning patterns
Agents no longer reason from scratch each time
Agent learning capability enters a new phase

articles.title_zh: QIMMA 阿拉伯語大語言模型排行榜上線
articles.title_en: QIMMA launches quality-first Arabic LLM benchmark leaderboard
articles.lede_zh: Hugging Face 上線 QIMMA 阿拉伯語大語言模型排行榜，專注於以質量為首要標準評估阿拉伯語模型表現。
articles.lede_en: The QIMMA leaderboard launched on Hugging Face, providing a quality-first evaluation benchmark for Arabic language large language models.
bullets_zh: 首個阿拉伯語 LLM 專項排行榜
以品質優先取代流量排序機制
推動少數語言 AI 評估標準發展
bullets_en: First dedicated Arabic LLM ranking platform
Quality-first approach replaces traffic scoring
Advancing evaluation standards for minority languages

articles.title_zh: 工程師轉管理不是升遷，而是職業轉換
articles.title_en: What engineers should consider before accepting a management role
articles.lede_zh: IEEE Spectrum 刊文探討工程師轉任管理職的挑戰，指出這並非升遷而是完全不同的職業，影響力的衡量方式從個人產出轉為透過團隊間接發揮。
articles.lede_en: IEEE Spectrum explores the challenges engineers face when transitioning to management, arguing it is a career switch rather than a promotion. Impact shifts from direct output to indirect influence through the team.
bullets_zh: 管理職非升遷而是全新職業軌跡
新經理人普遍缺乏系統性培訓
績效指標從個人產出轉向團隊影響
bullets_en: Management is a career change not a promotion
New managers typically lack formal training
Metrics shift from output to team impact

articles.title_zh: ThoughtWorks 技術雷達發布，AI 時代重探軟體工程基礎
articles.title_en: ThoughtWorks Tech Radar revisits software engineering foundations in the AI era
articles.lede_zh: ThoughtWorks 第 34 期技術雷達發布，118 項技術主題中 AI 占主導地位，同時強調配對程式設計、零信任架構、突變測試等基礎工藝的復甦。
articles.lede_en: ThoughtWorks released its 34th Technology Radar with 118 items. While AI dominates the landscape, the report highlights a resurgence of foundational practices like pair programming, zero trust architecture, and mutation testing.
bullets_zh: 第 34 期收錄 118 項技術主題
AI 工具生成複雜度促使重探基礎工藝
終端機重新成為開發者主要介面
bullets_en: Thirty-fourth edition covers 118 technology topics
AI complexity drives return to craft fundamentals
Terminal returns as primary developer interface

articles.title_zh: 吹哨者指控芬蘭新創固態電池技術名不副實
articles.title_en: Whistleblower alleges Finnish startup solid-state battery claims are false
articles.lede_zh: 芬蘭新創 Donut Lab 宣稱的固態電池快充與高儲能技術遭吹哨者質疑不實，事件已引發刑事訴訟。
articles.lede_en: A whistleblower has challenged Donut Lab's solid-state battery claims of fast charging and high energy storage. The allegations have escalated into a criminal complaint.
bullets_zh: Donut Lab 快充技術遭質疑造假
案件已升級為刑事投訴
固態電池產業面臨誠信考驗
bullets_en: Donut Lab fast charging claims challenged as false
Case has escalated into a criminal complaint
Solid-state battery sector faces integrity test

articles.title_zh: 創新住宅設計可降低非洲兒童多種致命疾病風險
articles.title_en: Simple house design helps prevent fatal diseases in African children
articles.lede_zh: 隨機對照試驗顯示，造價 8800 美元的改良住宅設計可減少非洲兒童瘧疾、腹瀉和呼吸道感染等致命疾病的發病率。
articles.lede_en: A randomized controlled trial shows an $8,800 improved house design can reduce malaria, diarrhea, and respiratory infections among African children.
bullets_zh: 改良住宅造價 8800 美元效益顯著
同時降低三種致命疾病發病風險
公共衛生基礎設施投資具成本效益
bullets_en: Eight thousand dollar design delivers proven health benefits
Reduces three fatal disease risks simultaneously
Public health infrastructure investment proves cost effective

articles.title_zh: 川普暫緩對伊朗軍事行動，外交斡旋爭取更多時間
articles.title_en: Trump backs off Iran escalation after frantic day of diplomacy
articles.lede_zh: 美國總統川普決定再次暫緩對伊朗升級軍事威脅，這是數週內第二次退讓，為外交談判爭取更多時間。
articles.lede_en: President Trump decided to back off escalating military threats against Iran, marking the second time in weeks he has stepped back, buying more time for diplomatic negotiations.
bullets_zh: 川普兩週內第二次暫緩軍事威脅
緊張局勢持續但外交管道運作中
中東局勢走向仍待觀察
bullets_en: Trump steps back from threats second time in weeks
Tensions persist but diplomatic channels remain active
Middle East trajectory still uncertain

articles.title_zh: AI 推論框架 SGLang 曝 RCE 漏洞，惡意模型可執行任意程式碼
articles.title_en: AI inference framework SGLang exposes RCE vulnerability through malicious models
articles.lede_zh: AI 推論框架 SGLang 被揭露存在遠端程式碼執行漏洞，攻擊者可在 GGUF 模型檔植入惡意酬載，透過 /v1/rerank 端點觸發任意程式碼，截至公告日仍無官方修補程式。
articles.lede_en: The SGLang AI inference framework has a remote code execution vulnerability. Attackers can embed malicious payloads in GGUF model files, triggering arbitrary code through the /v1/rerank endpoint. No official patch exists.
bullets_zh: GGUF 模型植入 Jinja2 惡意酬載可觸發攻擊
截至 4 月 20 日官方尚未發布修補程式
使用 SGLang 的服務應提高警戒
bullets_en: Jinja2 payloads in GGUF models trigger the attack
No official patch available as of April twentieth
Services running SGLang should increase vigilance
